name: Pontianak
description: The Pontianak (known as Kuntilanak in Indonesia) is a vengeful female vampire spirit in Malay and Indonesian folklore, originating from women who died during pregnancy or childbirth. She appears as a beautiful woman in white to lure victims before revealing her monstrous true form.

aliases.name: Kuntilanak
aliases.meaning: Indonesian variant name; derived from the same root

aliases.name: Kunti
aliases.meaning: Colloquial abbreviation used in Indonesian popular culture

origin: Pontianak / Kuntilanak beliefs are widespread throughout the Malay Archipelago, including Malaysia, Indonesia (especially Kalimantan, Java, and Sumatra), Singapore, and Brunei.
